column1: # BabelSoft XinJiu Zixing (新字形/旧字形) Mappings

#   Chinese character forms. This is distinct from simplified/traditional;
#   it covers orthographic form differences within the same script.

#   2. target_codepoint     - Unicode codepoint in U+XXXXXX format
